# KI-144 — Web: local owner account mode

**Lane:** web · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** claude-opus · **Depends on:** KI-101 · **Serializes with:** none
**Plan context (pinned):** [plan](../../../plans/2026-10-02-001-feat-internal-mode-plan.md) · [contracts](../contracts.md) · [roster and graph](../roster.md) · researched at `7672b0e5` (first researched at `5ad41c8b`; see reconciliation.md R-REFRESH)
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `apps/web/src/composition/human/mount.tsx`, `apps/web/src/composition/human/mount.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/composition/human/mount-account.test.tsx` (new), `apps/web/src/composition/human/screen.tsx` (one optional render prop), `apps/web/src/composition/human/room.tsx` (two copy strings and one hook call), `apps/web/src/composition/human/browser-harness/local-owner.html` (new), `apps/web/src/composition/human/browser-harness/local-owner.tsx` (new), `apps/web/src/composition/human/local-owner.browser.spec.ts` (new), and conditionally one rule in `apps/web/src/ui/khala/khala-app.css` (Step 4)
**Refresh @ `7672b0e5` (2026-10-02):** #976 (roster rename), #986 (initials API), #988 and #989 (Profile dialog: username + colour; replaces the Username menu item) merged since `5ad41c8b`. UI selectors, menu items and line pointers below are refreshed; #978 (per-human colours) and #982 (Initials field) are still open.

## Outcome

`HumanApplicationScreen` and `mountKhalaContent` accept `account?: 'oauth' | 'local_owner'`. The default is `'oauth'`, which renders byte for byte as today.

With `account: 'local_owner'`, which the local entry passes (KI-143):
- The brand-row Settings menu holds only **Light/Dark mode** and **Profile** (#989 replaced the Username item with Profile, which opens `ProfileDialog`). There is no **Log out** in the ready shell, the pending shell or the username gate.
- The app never starts a sign-in redirect.
- When the helper is unreachable or the browser has no owner session, the app shows one compact panel: **Not connected**, then the command `khala local open` with a copy button. There is no explanatory prose.
- A channel the owner can no longer open says "You no longer have access to this channel." instead of "…encrypted conversation".

Screenshots of the menu and the panel at 1280 and 390, dark and light, are attached to the PR.

## Context and evidence

- **D4:** local "owner" mode skips Google sign-in. **AE5:** "The owner opens the open link: no Google sign-in". **R10:** hosted behaviour and tests unchanged.
- `research/web-seam.md` §3.3 items 2 and 5, and §9 risk 6:
  - Log out is always offered in the ready shell (`apps/web/src/composition/human/mount.tsx:271-277`) and on signed-in failures (`apps/web/src/composition/human/mount.tsx:356`).
  - Clicking it would put the local app into `signed_out` (`apps/web/src/composition/human/application.ts:193-199`).
  - `SignInRedirect` (`apps/web/src/composition/human/mount.tsx:120-156`) auto-navigates on any `signed_out` snapshot.
  - Local channels are not encrypted, so the "encrypted conversation" copy at `apps/web/src/composition/human/room.tsx:148` and `apps/web/src/composition/human/room.tsx:162` is wrong locally.
- The local `IdentityPort` (KI-140, L13) answers `signed_in` or `unavailable`, never `signed_out`. Today an `unavailable` identity snapshot falls through to the generic "Account and device status" frame (`apps/web/src/composition/human/screen.tsx:136-142`), whose text is "Khala is unavailable right now (identity_unavailable)." `mount.tsx` cannot replace that branch, so this ticket adds one optional render prop to `HumanScreen`. With the prop omitted, the hosted path is identical.
- **Operator UI direction (2026-10-02):** minimal labeling and no helper sentences; short labels only where needed (accessible names may be visually hidden); polished spacing and tokens; screenshot and self-critique at 1280/390, dark and light.

### Decision: no "Local" marker in the brand row

Do **not** add a Local badge.
- The operator asked for minimal labeling.
- #973 (`cc561ded`) removed the brand row's only badge (Live) in favour of the Settings cog, and `apps/web/src/composition/human/mount.test.tsx:265-273` locks "no badge in the brand".
- The local app lists only local channels (plan P5) and runs at `127.0.0.1`, so inside the app there is nothing to disambiguate.
- At 390 px the brand row already holds the logo, the wordmark and the cog.
- The tab title carries the distinction instead: KI-143's `local.html` uses `<title>Khala · local</title>`.
- If a marker is ever wanted, the primitive is `StatusBadge` (`apps/web/src/shell/StatusBadge.tsx:9-11`, `tone="neutral"`, `label="Local"`) passed as `brandActions`. That is out of scope here.

## Scope

1. `mount.tsx`:
   - export `HumanAccountMode`, `HumanAccountContext` and `useHumanAccount`;
   - add `account` to `HumanApplicationScreenProps`, and therefore to `MountKhalaContentOptions`;
   - in `local_owner` mode, remove every Log out path and render `LocalOwnerUnavailable` for signed-out and identity-unavailable;
   - show a neutral spinner in place of "Signing in…" while the profile loads.
2. `screen.tsx`: one optional prop, `renderIdentityUnavailable?: (path: string) => ReactNode`, used only when supplied.
3. `room.tsx`: read `useHumanAccount()` once, and switch two strings in `local_owner` mode.
4. Tests:
   - SSR unit tests in `mount.test.tsx`;
   - prop-capture tests in `mount-account.test.tsx`;
   - a Playwright harness spec with screenshots.

## Non-goals

- Building the local ports, the local entry or `dist-local`: **KI-140..KI-143**. This ticket uses fake ports in its harness.
- The full-app flows against a faked helper (send, long-poll, roster modes, rename): **KI-145**.
- The Profile item and dialog in the Settings menu (#989, merged) and the Initials field (in-flight **#982**): not this build. Keep whatever items they add; only Log out is removed.
- Any copy change in `oauth` mode, any change to `LostDevicePanel`, `JoinRoute` or `AgentConfirmRoute`, and the "Checking your sign-in…" status text in `screen.tsx:49-62`. That text flashes for one loopback round trip; changing it would mean a second `screen.tsx` prop for no lasting benefit.
- `features/*` and `ui/*` components, apart from the one optional CSS rule in Step 4.

## Contract and invariants

L13 (KI-144), verbatim:

```ts
// apps/web/src/composition/human/mount.tsx (KI-144)
export type HumanAccountMode = 'oauth' | 'local_owner';
// HumanApplicationScreenProps and mountKhalaContent input gain `account?: HumanAccountMode` (default 'oauth').
// local_owner: no Log out item, no sign-in redirect; signed_out/unavailable identity renders one short panel naming `khala local open`.
```

What the local identity port does (L13, KI-140), verbatim:

```ts
  identity: IdentityPort;        // current(): GET /api/local/profile → {kind:'signed_in', principal: LOCAL_PRINCIPAL} | {kind:'unavailable', retryable:true}; NEVER signed_out
```

L12, the command the panel names: `khala local open [roomId|name]` → `{ openUrl, expiresAt }` (never launches a browser).

Additive names this ticket pins, which KI-143 consumes:

```ts
export type HumanAccountMode = 'oauth' | 'local_owner';
export const HumanAccountContext: React.Context<HumanAccountMode>;   // default 'oauth'
export function useHumanAccount(): HumanAccountMode;
// screen.tsx
renderIdentityUnavailable?: (path: string) => ReactNode;   // HumanScreenProps; only used for phase 'unavailable' && source 'identity'
```

### Invariants

1. **Zero hosted change.**
   - With `account` omitted or `'oauth'`, every existing test in `mount.test.tsx`, `device-loss.browser.spec.ts` and `username-setup.browser.spec.ts` passes unchanged.
   - SSR markup for every snapshot in `mount.test.tsx` is identical; the context provider adds no DOM.
2. **`local_owner` never calls `identity.beginSignIn`, `identity.signOut` or `application.signOut`,** whatever the snapshot.
3. **No Log out anywhere in `local_owner` mode:** no `aria-label="Log out"` button, no `menuitem` named Log out, no "Logging out…" or "Log out failed" text.
4. **One panel for both no-session states.** `signed_out` and `unavailable`/`identity` both render `LocalOwnerUnavailable`. Its visible text is exactly **Not connected** and **`khala local open`**; the copy button's accessible name is **Copy command**. No other words.
5. **Terminology:** new copy says "channel", never "room" or "chat" (`node scripts/check-terminology.mjs`).
6. **Hooks order:**
   - `useHumanAccount()` in `room.tsx` is called before the first early return (`room.tsx:107`);
   - `useSignOut` is still called unconditionally in both shells.

### Worked example

The panel's rendered markup inside the solo frame. The SSR test asserts this exact `kh-state-c` block; the svg is elided:

```html
<div class="kh-state"><div class="kh-state-c" role="alert"><b>Not connected</b><div class="kh-oneliner"><code>khala local open</code><button type="button" class="kh-ib sm" data-tip="Copy" aria-label="Copy command"><svg …></svg></button></div></div></div>
```

The menu, opened from the cog on `/conversations` in `local_owner` mode with username `kevin` in the dark theme. `allTextContents()` of `[role="menuitem"]` is `["Light mode", "Profile@kevin"]`. In `oauth` mode it is `["Light mode", "Profile@kevin", "Log out"]`. (The Profile item's detail is a colour swatch with no text, then `@kevin`; `apps/web/src/ui/khala/SettingsMenu.tsx:115-126`.)

### Steps

1. **`mount.tsx`: account plumbing.**
   1. Import `createContext` and `useContext` from React; `CopyIcon` from `../../ui/khala/icons` (the existing import at `:19`); `useToast` from `../../ui/khala/Toast`; `LoadingSpinner` from `../../ui/khala/LoadingSpinner`; `copyShareLink` from `../../ui/share-link`.
   2. Add, after the imports:
      ```ts
      export type HumanAccountMode = 'oauth' | 'local_owner';
      export const HumanAccountContext = createContext<HumanAccountMode>('oauth');
      /** How the human signed in: hosted OAuth, or the one local owner served by `khala local serve`. */
      export function useHumanAccount(): HumanAccountMode { return useContext(HumanAccountContext); }
      const LOCAL_OPEN_COMMAND = 'khala local open';
      ```
   3. Add to `HumanApplicationScreenProps`:
      ```ts
      /** `local_owner` (the local app) has no sign-in and no Log out. Default `oauth`. */
      account?: HumanAccountMode;
      ```
2. **`mount.tsx`: the panel.**
   ```tsx
   /** The local owner has no session: the helper is down, or this browser has no owner cookie yet. */
   function LocalOwnerUnavailable() {
     const toast = useToast();
     return <div className="kh-state-c" role="alert">
       <b>Not connected</b>
       <div className="kh-oneliner">
         <code>{LOCAL_OPEN_COMMAND}</code>
         <button type="button" className="kh-ib sm" data-tip="Copy" aria-label="Copy command"
           onClick={() => void copyShareLink(LOCAL_OPEN_COMMAND).then(result => { if (result.ok) toast('Copied'); })}><CopyIcon /></button>
       </div>
     </div>;
   }
   ```
